name: Addison Airport Toll Tunnel
facts: The Addison Airport Toll Tunnel, opened February 18, 1999, stretches 1,600 feet beneath the airport, cutting through Austin Chalk with a giant roadheader nicknamed "Big Mike."
NTTA’s 2009 removal of all toll booths made the AATT the first fully electronic toll tunnel in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, relying solely on TollTag and mail‑invoice payments.
When the tunnel opened, it immediately diverted over 10,000 vehicles daily from Belt Line Road, easing congestion that had surged by 10,000 cars per day after the runway extension in 1969.
